text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees finish their work faster. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works together with humans. For example, doctors use AI to analyse data while they make the final decisions. However, some jobs are disappearing, and new ones are appearing. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. In the future, human-AI collaboration will likely become normal in most workplaces.
